<thought>Only carbon shows a clear, multi‑peak isotopic envelope (M, M+1, M+2, …) with the expected decreasing intensities for a molecule containing several carbon atoms. No other element exhibits a distinctive pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) in this spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
